notes.title: Bugs fixed 27/11/2020!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38669989/097a60831a5221111b626c53bda2c8d1a2174ea8.png[/img]
We have fixed the reported bugs as below:
[list]
[*]Changed the sea tileset to another reasonable "water tileset".
[*]Amended four spirits side quest (Sacred maze).
[*]Added one side quest for painting to fulfill the hidden achievement.
[*]Amended the first save crystal in Bandit cave to server purpose for recover hp & mp only, no more save option.
[*]Added another 7 achievements. 
[*]Fixed the Revive skill issue after Alex changed his class.
[*]Fixed the Spike error in Magic tower
[*]Amended some dialog issue.
[/list]

We will keep on put in efforts to patch and update the game, please report any encountered bugs at discussion thread, we will fix it as soon as possible.

notes.title: Major bugs fixed 21/11/2020!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38669989/097a60831a5221111b626c53bda2c8d1a2174ea8.png[/img]
We have fixed the reported bugs as below:
[list]
[*]Jan's gift side quest no further action after fulfilled (Phoenix Town).
[*]Amended Carmen side quest's sequence (Liraq Town)
[*]Fixed Alex's picture when happen at Mage forest during Lidia battle.
[*]Fixed Cleansing Water skill to cure poison also,
[*]Amended Anthic Town's mayor quest Reward arrangement (Anthic Town). 
[*]Amended Broken Axe side quest (Liraq Town)
[*]Adding one more option/quest to obtain additional Paintings 
[*]Fixed the description for steal skill when do the stealing action.
[*]Fixed one misplaced Achievement for Geona Ending.
[/list]

We will keep on put in efforts to patch and update the game, please report any encountered bugs at discussion thread, we will fix it as soon as possible.
